svg.text: 2D Symptom Manifold with HDBSCAN Clusters & Support Vector Clustering (SVC) Boundaries
Shaded contours = RBF Support Vector Clustering (SVC) decision regions • Colored nodes = HDBSCAN dense symptom clusters • Gray nodes = unclustered transdiagnostic/unique symptoms
A. BioBERT NLI/STS (7 Clusters, Clustered=524/1,033, Silhouette=0.390)
B. PubMedBERT Embeddings (11 Clusters, Clustered=532/1,033, Silhouette=0.366)
